original.target_description: Experiment 4b: 24 native French-speaking undergraduates, four Target × Digit Combination groups; recognition-test correct responses, initial mixed ANOVA main effect of dependency type (adjacent versus nonadjacent), with digit combination and target as between-subjects factors. Computer-paced digit presentation.

n.sample_role: Participants in Experiment 4b recognition-test ANOVA; four groups of 6. The reported F(1, 20) and accompanying t(23) tests are consistent with all 24 participants.
